You’re comparing

$$\text{Quantity A}=\frac{x^2-1}{x+1}
\qquad\text{and}\qquad
\text{Quantity B}=x-1,$$

with $x\ne -1$.

Start by factoring the numerator of Quantity A using the difference-of-squares pattern. What does $x^2-1$ factor into? Then check whether you can cancel a factor, keeping the restriction $x\ne -1$ in mind.
